details.flavorMarkdown: *A rough humanoid of fired and unfired clay, with broad hands and the maker’s thumbprints still visible. It understands simple work instructions but has no independent craft training.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Clay palm

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Construct: ordinary HP healing does not repair it; destroyed at 0. Combat repair requires an explicit repair ability. Workshop repair remains a design question.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Wet clay patches mend the same pair of footprints.

**Purpose:** Complete one simple assigned task.

**Tactics and retreat:** Use Force to clear a route; strike only if commanded or threatened.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Give a valid instruction or show the maker’s token.

**Habitat:** Workshop; farm · **Communication:** Understands Common instructions; cannot speak

**Loot:** A maker’s mark and ordinary tools, if present; the body is not a free material supply.

**Summoning:** Construct 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/summons/clay-helper.md).

# Lifeless Body

*Nothing breathes beneath the torn coat; nothing living looks through the visor.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-lifeless-body


**Action:** Passive

The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food. Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
